entries.headline: Design/base separates task identity from working source

intent.text: Keep revision-labelled task context separate from editable instructions and independently captured source; attaching a task must not open files or command an agent.

outcome.text: The supplied design artifact specifies exact commit/blob identity and core revalidation. Git records the design and base merges, with document, protocol, core and test paths changed.

decision.text: Recommendation: reconcile the design's unfinished D3-only status paragraph with the later UI/core merges before using it as a current delivery summary.

caveats: The artifact is a supplied paraphrase; Git subjects and changed paths establish recorded changes, not correctness.
Card order presents a progression, not proof of causal dependencies.

entries.headline: Attachment UI preserves an independently chosen source

intent.text: Make task attachment deliberate through Append/Replace/Cancel/Remove while retaining draft source and rejecting stale proposals.

outcome.text: D5 reports packaged attachment checks at 100%/150%, retained dirty state and zero renderer exceptions; Git records PR49's UI merge. Attached Prepare still returned UNSUPPORTED_CONTROL at that milestone.

decision.text: Recommendation: treat this as the attachment milestone, and use the separately recorded core evidence to assess joined preparation.

caveats: UI behavior and checks are D5's attributed report, not independently rerun here.
Later merges do not retroactively change the reported UI milestone's unsupported preparation result.

entries.headline: Core resolver reports exact task-byte materialization

intent.text: Verify task identity, commit and blob in core, then materialize bounded canonical text and independently revalidate metadata, source and configuration.

outcome.text: D4 reports Git/YAML resolution, cancellation/drain and task-specific preparation timing. Its initial recap was held before peer clearance; later Git records PR50 merged with resolver, core and test paths changed.

decision.text: Recommendation: use the later Git merge as the landing observation, not the initial recap; retain the production-policy boundary when describing readiness.

caveats: The bundle does not explain how peer clearance was resolved; the later merge does not establish that causal story.
Production launch remained ADAPTER_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE in the report; deterministic admission/history is not production model execution.

entries.headline: Recorded joined proof preserves 81 history records

intent.text: Establish recovery and postclose history preservation while keeping real Git/Ditz and resolver work distinct from deterministic admitted output.

outcome.text: D6 reports immutable 81-record history and cleanup. ROOT's imported check records equal pre/post hashes, two core generations, no replayed commands and owned PIDs absent; Git independently records PR51 merged.

decision.text: Recommendation: retain the accepted proof with its attribution and keep topology-timeout and resize-warning follow-ups open; a warning-free run is not evidence of a fix.

caveats: ROOT's build/test and lifecycle verification is an imported recorded check, not a Journal rerun.
The production proof recorded modelTurns=0; the separate rehearsal recorded fixtureOnly=true and externalAgentProcesses=0.
The resize warning remained nonblocking under reported user disposition; the original topology timeout also remained open.
Generator provenance identifies this supervised authoring run only. The UI did not execute a model.
